theater: 關中京兆府與川陝邊境

battle.name: 宋金川陝爭奪戰
battle.theater: 關中京兆府與川陝邊境
battle.brief: 靖康元年冬金西路軍由河東南下，取河中、陷京兆，關中與陝西諸州相繼淪陷，宋朝西北四路與四川為之割絕；靖康二年四月汴京城破，北宋覆亡，宋室南渡後改以四川為根本，在大散關、和尚原一線與金人拉鋸十餘年。十字弩守城居高壓制鐵騎，野戰因裝填遲緩而受制，取捨全在城垣與隘口。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 交戰的兩方是女真建立的金朝與北宋。一一二七年時金朝皇帝是太宗完顏晟，開國的太祖完顏阿骨打已於一一二三年病逝，南侵的部署由金廷在燕京的樞密院逐路下達：中路以粘罕領兵自雲州南下攻太原，西路以斜也領兵由河東切入陝西，東路由宗望與斡離不自平州方向南下，三路指向汴京。金軍以猛安謀克為骨幹，雜以契丹、漢人及新附的簽軍，攻城沿途設陝西統軍司與招討司，以降人充任地方官吏，並把漢軍屯於關中以為久駐之基。北宋方面，陝西由沿邊招討司、鄜延路、熙河路、秦鳳路等分兵把守，主力是禁軍的騎兵與步軍，輔以各縣弓手、寨兵與民間義軍，鄜延一線的守臣張叔夜曾以本部兵拒金人於州境；汴京一線由徽宗、欽宗坐鎮，李綱一度主持城防，張俊、宗澤、韓世忠等分守河北、山東。戰後宋室南渡，金廷在中原扶植劉豫建立偽齊，川陝邊線自此變成宋、金、偽齊三方拉鋸的格局，一直延續到宋金和議劃定疆界。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Jin dynasty founded by the Jurchen and the Northern Song. In 1127 the Jin emperor was Taizong Wanyan Sheng; the founding Taizu Wanyan Aguda had died in 1123, and the plan for the southern invasion was issued column by column by the Jin Privy Council at Yanjing. The central column was led by Nahan south from Yunzhou against Taiyuan, the western column by Xieye through Hedong into Shaanxi, and the eastern column by Zongwang and Wolibu from Pingzhou, all three converging on Bianjing. The Jin army had the meng'an mouke as its backbone, mixed with Khitan, Han and newly submitted Han levy troops; along the way it set up a Shaanxi Army Command Office and a Pacification Office staffed by surrendered officials, and quartered Han troops in Guanzhong as a permanent base. On the Song side Shaanxi was divided among the Frontier Pacification Office and the Fuyan, Xihe and Qinfeng circuits, with the cavalry and infantry of the imperial guards as the main strength, supported by county archers, village garrisons and armed volunteers; in the Fuyan area the commander Zhang Shuye once turned back Jin troops with the men of his own circuit. The Bianjing front was personally overseen by Huizong and Qinzong; Li Gang directed the city defence for a time, while Zhang Jun, Zong Ze and Han Shizhong guarded Hebei and Shandong. After the Song court fled south, the Jin installed Liu Yu's puppet Qi state in the Central Plain, and the Sichuan-Shaanxi front became a three-way tug of war between Song, Jin and the puppet, running on until the Song-Jin peace settlement fixed the frontier.
people: 關鍵人物橫跨兩朝。金廷方面，太宗完顏晟在宣和末年便拍板傾國南侵，把目標由燕雲擴到中原；粘罕以中路主帥身份圍困太原，斜也則是西路軍統帥，他自河東打到河中、京兆，後來又率軍攻擊川陝邊緣的仙人關，是這條戰線上宋金反覆對壘的同一個人。北宋末年的君臣中，徽宗以道教政治與童貫、蔡京的財政變法掏空了西北軍政，欽宗即位後罷免主戰的李綱，散掉勤王兵，北宋的抵抗能力因此在關鍵時刻崩落；李綱隨後南渡，建炎年間兩度自江西入衛，被指為擁兵自重而遭貶謫，終老長沙。陝西方面的關鍵人物是曲端，這位出身關中的宿將收復華州一帶，被授以陝西經略安撫副使，兵眾自稱護夏軍；他與吳玠同為川陝防務的支柱，後來卻被趙鼎、秦檜猜忌，終在建炎末被擒殺於貶所途中，部眾隨之潰散，吳玠接手其防區才穩住局面。吳玠在建炎四年收復和尚原、翌年即紹興元年與吳璘在仙人關擊退金軍，確立南線的防衛格局；張浚、劉光世、宗澤先後主持或參與川陝軍務，張浚還在建炎四年率軍進取關中而於富平大敗，關中最後一次收復的企圖就此破滅。
peopleEn: Key figures span both courts. On the Jin side, Taizong Wanyan Sheng decided in the closing years of the Xuanhe era to commit the state to a full-scale southern invasion, widening the aim from Yanyun to the Central Plain; Nahan besieged Taiyuan as commander of the central column, while Xieye commanded the western column, fighting from Hedong through Hezhong and Jingzhao and returning years later to attack Xianrenguan on the edge of the Sichuan-Shaanxi front, the same man who would meet the Song there again and again. Among the late Northern Song court, Huizong hollowed out the northwest military administration through Daoist politics and the fiscal experiments of Tong Guan and Cai Jing; Qinzong then dismissed the bellicose Li Gang and disbanded the relief armies, and the dynasty's capacity to resist collapsed at the decisive moment. Li Gang followed the court south, twice marched into the imperial camp from Jiangxi during the Jianyan years, was accused of using his troops for personal leverage and was demoted, dying in Changsha. The key figure in Shaanxi was Qu Duan, a veteran of Guanzhong who recovered Huazhou and the country west of it, was appointed deputy pacification commissioner for Shaanxi, and whose troops called themselves the Husha army. He and Wu Jie together formed the pillars of the Sichuan-Shaanxi defence, yet Qu Duan was distrusted by Zhao Ding and Qin Hui and was seized and killed on the road to his exile at the end of the Jianyan era; his command dispersed with him and Wu Jie took over his sector before the line could settle. Wu Jie recovered Heshangyuan in the fourth year of Jianyan and the next year, the first year of Shaoxing, beat back the Jin army at Xianrenguan together with Wu Lin, fixing the defensive shape of the southern line. Zhang Jun, Liu Guangshi and Zong Ze at various times directed or joined the Sichuan-Shaanxi war effort, and Zhang Jun himself led the Song army into Guanzhong in the fourth year of Jianyan and was badly beaten at Fuping, ending the last attempt to recover Guanzhong.
kits: 十字弩是這條戰線上守城與野戰取捨的具體寫照。宋初曾公亮所編《武經總要》留下弩、弓、砲與各類攻城器械的圖樣，陣圖中弩手多列於陣前，長槍與刀盾居中偏後。宋軍的弩兵分三個層次：腰繫的臂弩數十步內可用，隨身攜帶，適合驟然齊射；裝在車板上的床子弩與車弩架在城頭或軍陣之後，專門壓制成排進攻的攻城部隊；最重的是神臂弓，熙寧以後從西夏仿製推廣，拉弦要人足踏或數人協力，一發可穿重甲，有效射程能到一百五十步以上，宋人記載更遠者甚至可及三百步，而弩機、弩弦、箭桿都靠匠人分件修製，壞一件就廢一件。野戰中弩的弱點正是裝填緩慢：十字弩把射速交給了機械，發射之後必須重新蹶弦上矢，騎兵一旦衝進弩手的近身距離就難以再射，因此宋廷在西北倚賴的總是山地與城池，弓弩在守城中也比在原野上可靠。金軍攻城則反過來用砲與穴地對付弩的封鎖：砲火壓制城頭，穴地避開弩手居高臨下的直射，雲梯貼上城牆之際也正是弩手失去射界之時。箭分習箭、毒箭與火箭，火箭用來燒燔攻城器械，毒箭在守城反擊時施放，宋廷守汴京時還用霹靂砲炸毀過金軍的攻城塔。雙方都備雲梯、搭鈎、撞竿；金軍騎兵以鐵甲為主，另有攻城槌與飛石，糧秣靠黃河與渭水的漕運以及就地徵發，關中失陷後宋廷的西北漕運即告斷絕。
kitsEn: The crossbow is the concrete expression of the trade-off between siege and field work on this front. The Wujing Zongyao compiled by Zeng Gongliang in the early Song preserves diagrams of crossbows, bows, stone-throwing engines and every kind of siege machine; in its battle arrays the crossbowmen are placed in front, with spearmen and sword-and-shield troops behind them. The Song crossbow troops were organised in three layers. The waist-carried hand crossbow was usable within a few dozen paces, could be carried by the man himself and was good for a sudden mass shot. The bed-nu mounted on a plank and the cart crossbow were set up on the wall-heads or behind the battle line, and existed to press massed assault columns. Heaviest of all was the shenbi gong, copied from the Western Xia and pushed into service after the Xining era: the bow had to be strung by a man bracing his foot on the stirrup or by several men pulling together, one bolt could pierce heavy armour, and the effective range ran beyond 150 paces, Song writers even putting the extreme figure at 300. Nuts, bowstrings and shafts were made and repaired by craftsmen piece by piece, so a single lost part put a weapon out of action. The weakness of the crossbow in the open field was exactly its slow loading. The crossbow handed rate of fire over to the machine, and after a shot the operator had to re-crank the nut and re-seat the bolt; once cavalry closed to the crossbowmen's short range the weapon could not be fired again. That is why the Song in the northwest always leaned on hill country and walled cities, and why the crossbow was far more reliable in a siege than on a plain. Jin siegecraft answered the crossbow's coverage in reverse, with artillery and mining: gunfire suppressed the wall-heads, tunnels avoided the direct plunging fire of the crossbowmen, and the moment a scaling ladder touched the wall was the moment the crossbowmen lost their field of fire. Arrows were plain, poisoned or incendiary; fire arrows burned siege machines, poisoned arrows were loosed in counterattacks from the walls, and the Song defence of Bianjing once destroyed Jin assault towers with thunder-crash bombs. Both sides carried scaling ladders, hooks and battering beams. Jin cavalry were armoured in iron, with rams and stone-throwing engines besides; food and fodder came by the Yellow River and the Wei, and by requisition on the spot, and once Guanzhong was lost the Song's northwest grain traffic was cut off with it.
tactics: 金軍西路在陝西的戰法，是把騎兵的速度與攻城器械的火力結合起來。河東與關中之間多山谷通道，騎兵沿汾河、涑水、黃河南岸到渭水北岸逐段推進，每到一處要地便分兵圍城、留一部監視宋軍援兵，既斷糧道也阻援。圍城往往拖延數月，攻城方以砲轟擊城頭，逼迫守軍縮入女牆，弩手因此失去射界；再以穴地掘進或雲梯同時壓上。宋軍守城多依城樓分層配置弓弩，遠射的弩手居高壓制，步弓與長槍手在城門缺口後列陣，等攻城隊伍進入弩的射程才放手齊射，並趁換梯、填壕的空檔出城夜襲，焚燒攻城器械，又在夜裡以小隊襲營破其繼援之具。陝西失守之後，川陝邊界的守御改為據險：吳玠放棄秦鳳一線，退守大散關、和尚原一帶，用山脊與隘口分割平地，使金軍鐵騎無法展開，弩手在關隘兩側的制高點射擊，槍兵結陣擋住通道，步騎之間以旗鼓傳訊而非號角，進退全看旗號。糧道成為全線關鍵，川軍與陝軍的接濟須經劍門、昭化沿嘉陵水路上行，陝軍失地之後只剩陸路一線，宋金都試圖切斷這條線，最終形成以大散關為界、斷續拉鋸十餘年的局面。
tacticsEn: The Jin western column fought in Shaanxi by combining the speed of cavalry with the firepower of siege machines. Between Hedong and Guanzhong lie a series of valley routes, and the cavalry advanced stage by stage along the Fen, the Sui, the south bank of the Yellow River and the north bank of the Wei. At each important place they split off to invest the city and left a detachment to watch for Song relief columns, cutting the supply road and blocking reinforcements at one and the same time. Sieges were usually dragged out for months: the besiegers hammered the wall-heads with artillery, driving the defenders down behind the parapets so that the crossbowmen lost their field of fire, then advanced with mining and scaling ladders together. Song garrisons normally distributed bows and crossbows in layers among the wall towers, with the long-range crossbowmen above, and bowmen and spearmen drawn up behind the breaches, holding their fire until the assault columns came within crossbow range and then releasing mass volleys; they also sallied out at night during the intervals when ladders were being changed or the ditch filled, setting fire to the siege machines, and sent out night parties to break up the enemy's siege train. Once Shaanxi was lost, the defence of the Sichuan-Shaanxi border changed to holding the heights. Wu Jie gave up the Qinfeng line and fell back on Dasan Pass and Heshangyuan, using ridges and defiles to break up the open ground so that Jin iron cavalry could not deploy; crossbowmen shot from the commanding heights on both sides of the passes, spearmen formed ranks to bar the way, and foot and horse units signalled to each other by flags and drums rather than horns, every advance and withdrawal keyed to the signal flags. The supply line was the hinge of the whole front. The relief of the Sichuan and Shaanxi armies had to travel up the Jialing waterway through Jiange and Zhaohua, and once the Shaanxi armies were lost only one overland route remained; both Song and Jin tried to cut it. The result was a line fixed at Dasan Pass, fought back and forth for more than a decade.
data: 可核對的數字並不多，但有幾個節點相當確定。靖康元年十月金軍三路南下的總兵力，後世多稱二十萬上下，其中西路軍自河東入陝西的騎兵以數萬計；圍太原的宋軍連同各路勤王兵約數萬，攻城自十月延到十二月，城破時主將與守臣相繼死於亂軍，金軍在時間上取得明顯優勢。京師方面，汴京的禁軍名額據載在十萬以上、接近二十萬，但缺額與吃空餉普遍，靖康二年三月金軍進逼城下，四月城破，徽、欽二帝與大批宗室官員被俘北上。守城一方能倚仗的射擊數據仍有痕跡：一般步弓的有效射程約七十至一百步，弩可到一百五十步上下，神臂弓的記載更遠，達二百步以上、傳聞可及三百步；弩的單兵射速低於弓，一發之後重新上弦往往要數息到數十息，正是野戰中弩手最脆弱的時段。關中失陷的時間並非一朝一夕：河中在靖康元年冬失守，京兆在翌年初淪陷，鄜延、熙河、洮岷各州相繼淪陷，至年中關中、陝北盡入金手。事件表上，川陝拉鋸從一一二七年延到一一四一年紹興和議，屆時以淮水與大散關劃界；一一三〇年張浚收兵關中於富平失利，一一三一年吳玠於仙人關破金軍，才把邊界穩定在大散關一線。
dataEn: Few of the figures can be checked, but several landmarks are solid. The total strength with which the Jin armies moved south in the tenth month of the first year of Jingkang is usually put at around 200,000 in later sources, of which the western column's cavalry entering Shaanxi from Hedong numbered in the tens of thousands; the Song troops besieged at Taiyuan, together with the relief armies from various routes, amounted to some thousands, the siege running from the tenth month to the twelfth, and when the city fell the commander and the civil governor were killed in the confusion, the Jin clearly ahead on the clock. In the capital, the nominal strength of the Bianjing imperial guards is recorded at over 100,000 and near 200,000, but vacancies and dead pay were widespread; in the third month of the second year of Jingkang the Jin closed on the city, the walls fell in the fourth month, and Huizong, Qinzong and a great many of the imperial clan and officials were carried north. The shooting figures of the defence can still be traced: the effective range of an ordinary bow was about seventy to a hundred paces, the crossbow reached roughly a hundred and fifty, and the shenbi gong is recorded further, beyond two hundred paces and by rumour as far as three hundred. The individual rate of fire of a crossbow was below that of a bow, and re-cocking and re-loading after a shot took from several breaths to several tens of breaths, precisely the interval in which a crossbowman was most vulnerable in the open field. The loss of Guanzhong did not happen in a single day: Hezhong fell in the winter of the first year of Jingkang, Jingzhao in the opening months of the second, and the circuits of Fuyan, Xihe and Taomin followed in turn, so that by midsummer Guanzhong and northern Shaanxi were wholly in Jin hands. The chronology runs from 1127 to the Shaoxing peace settlement of 1141, which drew the frontier along the Huai and Dasan Pass. The Song attempt to retake Guanzhong under Zhang Jun failed at Fuping in 1130, and only Wu Jie's victory at Xianrenguan in 1131 fixed the line on Dasan Pass.
cause: 這場戰爭的起因串連著金滅遼後的國際格局。女真於一一一九年起兵，一一二〇年宋金訂下海上之盟共同攻遼，至一一二五年遼亡；金廷很快發現宋軍攻遼的戰力有限，而燕雲十六州正是女真必須拿回的核心。宣和七年冬金軍第一次南侵，攻陷燕京、兵逼汴京，北宋靠李綱主持城防與各地勤王兵勉強迫退敵軍，但徽宗退位、欽宗換掉主戰之臣、裁撤民兵與勤王兵，等於拆掉自己的防線，靖康元年十月金軍再傾國而來。金廷內部在阿骨打死後由太宗完顏晟當家，他不再滿足於奪回燕雲，目標改為直接吞下中原，關鍵在於西北四路的存亡：燕雲尚可依地勢固守，關中卻是宋廷西北漕運與勤王兵東下的孔道，也是金軍自河東南下最平順的通道。川陝是關中的門戶：拿下陝西，宋朝的西北四路與四川就彼此斷絕，金軍可從側翼威脅蜀口，也可以在攻汴京時切斷西北勤王兵與漕糧的來路。於是靖康元年冬西路軍先取河中，翌年初進軍京兆，關中、鄜延、熙河、洮岷各州相繼淪陷；北宋的崩潰又反過來加深了宋金在川陝的拉鋸，新朝廷在失去關中後只能以四川為根本，與金人展開長達十餘年的邊境爭奪。
causeEn: The origins of this war run back to the international settlement after the Jin had destroyed the Liao. The Jurchen rose in 1119; in 1120 Song and Jin concluded the maritime alliance to attack the Liao together, and by 1125 the Liao was gone. The Jin court soon discovered that the Song army had little strength for the conquest, and that the sixteen prefectures of Yanyun were precisely what the Jurchen had to win back. In the winter of the seventh year of Xuanhe the Jin invaded for the first time, taking Yanjing and pushing up to Bianjing; the Northern Song barely held the capital off through Li Gang's city defence and the relief armies of the provinces, but the retirement of Huizong, the replacement of the war party by Qinzong and the dissolution of the militia and the relief troops tore down the dynasty's own defences, and in the tenth month of the first year of Jingkang the Jin came over the border once more in full force. Within the Jin court, with Aguda dead, Taizong Wanyan Sheng was in charge; no longer content with taking back Yanyun, he set his sights on swallowing the Central Plain outright. What decided the matter was the fate of the four northwest circuits. Yanyun could still be held on its ground, but Guanzhong was the corridor down which the Song's northwestern grain traffic and relief armies moved east and the smoothest road down for a Jin army coming from Hedong. Shaanxi was the gateway to Guanzhong: take Shaanxi and the Song's four northwest circuits would be cut off from Sichuan, the Jin could threaten the Sichuan mouth from the flank, and the western relief armies and the grain traffic of the Central Plain could be cut off while Bianjing was attacked. The western column accordingly took Hezhong in the winter of the first year of Jingkang and entered Jingzhao in the opening months of the second year, and the cities of Guanzhong, Fuyan, Xihe and Taomin fell in turn. The collapse of the Northern Song in turn deepened the Song-Jin struggle over Shaanxi and Sichuan: having lost Guanzhong, the new court had to make Sichuan its base and wage a border war lasting more than a decade.
impact: 直接後果是北宋覆亡與一條新國界線的形成。關中陷落使西北四路的大批兵丁、屯田與熙河的茶馬之利盡歸敵手，宋廷只能退到淮水以南；關中與陝北的人眾大批南遷，把川陝邊界的糧源兵源抽空，川軍一度靠襄樊、荊湖的轉運維持，關中與蜀口之間的接力供應再也接不起來。技術上，這段拉鋸把弩的地位推到最高：守方在城頭與隘口以弩壓制騎兵，攻方被迫發展砲火與穴地，雲梯攻城必先遭弩手居高射擊，神臂弓也在南渡後成為弩兵的標準裝備，軍中專設弩手營與教習，弩與砲的對峙從此成為宋金攻防的基本題目。對金朝而言，打通關中後仍未能深入四川，紹興元年仙人關的失利說明單靠騎兵與攻城器械不足以吃掉蜀地，金廷轉而扶植劉豫的偽齊，讓傀儡政權去承擔中原戰事，金兵則退回關中，把川口讓給傀儡軍去試。長期看，這條戰線改變了南北的經濟重心與人口分布，陝西此後成為金、西夏與蒙古交錯的地帶，直至十三世紀三十年代蒙古南下借道攻金，關中才換了主人。
impactEn: The immediate consequences were the end of the Northern Song and the drawing of a new frontier. With Guanzhong lost, the army rolls, the garrison farms and the tea-and-horse trade of the northwest circuits fell to the enemy, and the Song court could only fall back south of the Huai. Large numbers of people from Guanzhong and northern Shaanxi moved south, draining the grain and manpower of the Sichuan-Shaanxi border; the Sichuan army depended for a time on the transshipment of supplies through Xiangyang and the Jinghu lakes, and the relay of supply between Guanzhong and the Sichuan mouth could never be made good again. Technologically, the long struggle pushed the crossbow to the top of the armoury: the defenders used it from the wall-heads and the passes to hold down cavalry, the attackers were driven to develop artillery and mining, a scaling ladder going up to the wall was met first by plunging crossbow fire, and the shenbi gong became standard equipment for crossbow units after the move south, with dedicated crossbow companies and drill instructors in the army; from then on the duel between crossbow and siege engine became a standing problem of Song and Jin attack and defence. For the Jin, opening Guanzhong still did not bring them into Sichuan, and the defeat at Xianrenguan in the first year of Shaoxing showed that cavalry and siege machines alone could not swallow Shu; the court therefore propped up Liu Yu's puppet Qi and let the puppet state carry the war in the Central Plain, while the Jin troops fell back into Guanzhong and left the Sichuan mouth to the puppet army to test. In the long run this front shifted the economic centre of gravity and the distribution of population between north and south. Shaanxi became a zone where Jin, Western Xia and Mongols overlapped, and only with the Mongol advance through Song territory against Jin in the 1230s did Guanzhong change hands again.
result: 就一一二七年這一季而言，結果是金軍的完勝：河中、京兆先後陷落，關中與陝西各州在半年內接連易主，汴京隨即被圍而陷，徽宗、欽宗被俘北上，北宋就此終結，宋室的立國中心由汴京移到江寧與臨安。但戰線並未因關中陷落而關閉，蜀地仍在宋廷手中，宋朝在失去關中後反而以四川為根本重建了西北防禦，吳玠於建炎四年收復和尚原、翌年與吳璘在仙人關擊退金軍，把川陝的界線釘在大散關一線；金軍此後再攻川口多折而去，遂改以偽齊軍進逼，偽齊攻宋則在順昌一役再敗。經過一一二七至一一三〇年間數度拉鋸，紹興十一年宋軍收復興州、階州，一一四一年紹興和議以淮水至大散關劃定疆界，川陝爭奪告一段落，關中與陝西四路留在金朝手中，直到金亡之後才被蒙古接管。對宋人而言，這場戰爭輸掉的是西北，換來的是南方的立國根基；對金人而言，攻下關中只用了一年，卻在此後十四年裡始終無法越過大散關。
resultEn: For the campaigning season of 1127 the result was a complete Jin victory: Hezhong and Jingzhao fell, the cities of Guanzhong and Shaanxi changed hands within half a year, Bianjing was invested and then stormed, Huizong and Qinzong were carried off to the north, the Northern Song came to an end, and the centre of Song government moved from Bianjing to Jiangning and then to Lin'an. But the front did not close simply because Guanzhong was lost. Shu was still in Song hands, and instead of the northwest the Song rebuilt its defence on the basis of Sichuan: Wu Jie recovered Heshangyuan in the fourth year of Jianyan and the following year he and Wu Lin beat back the Jin army at Xianrenguan, nailing the Sichuan-Shaanxi line onto Dasan Pass. Later Jin attacks on the Sichuan mouth broke on the same ground, and the Jin turned instead to pressing forward with the armies of the puppet state, which were themselves beaten by the Song at Shunchang. After repeated seesaws between 1127 and 1130, Song forces recovered Xingzhou and Jiezhou in the eleventh year of Shaoxing, and the Shaoxing peace settlement of 1141 fixed the frontier from the Huai to Dasan Pass. The contest over Shaanxi and Sichuan was settled for the time being, with Guanzhong and the four northwest circuits left in Jin hands until the Mongols took them over after the fall of the Jin. For the Song, this war cost them the northwest and bought them the foundations of a state in the south; for the Jin, taking Guanzhong took a single year, but for the fourteen years that followed they never got past Dasan Pass.
